A real keyless signature, for testing the offline identity path of `hex_verify_update`:
`cosign_checksums.txt` and `cosign_checksums.txt.sigstore.json` from the sigstore/cosign v3.1.3
release, signed by `keyless@projectsigstore.iam.gserviceaccount.com` (issuer
`https://accounts.google.com`) and recorded in Rekor. Checked against `data/sigstore/trusted_root.json`.
